title: fix(studio): a PageShell row with nothing of its own draws no lone hairline; pin the title-row tenants outside studio-design
body:
Fixes #37520

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:应用搭建里元数据列表页和详情页的标题行,若这一行自己没有按钮或统计,末尾 AI 助手按钮前不再多画一条孤零零的分隔竖线;其余全是测试补强,用户无感。
- 为什么做:属于「Studio 顶栏迁出」这一系列工作的收尾:上一轮把保存和 AI 按钮搬进了各页标题行,但其中几处位置、面板开关、深色模式和多页面同时挂载的配色计数都没有测试守护,删掉也不会有任何报警。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是某个标题行多一条或少一条分隔竖线,不涉及数据和权限,可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

Pins for the Studio title-row tenants that PR #37474 placed outside `studio-design/**`, plus one product change (N3), as the contract record on #37474 asked (findings S1, S2, N1, N3, N4).

- **N3 (product, `PageShell.tsx` only):** both PageShell rows (compact and list) now pass `divider` to `StudioTitleRowEnd`, computed from the row's own stats and actions. A row with neither draws the assistant with no hairline before it; Save still brings the hairline, as `StudioTitleRowEnd` already counts it as an action. This matches what the item header and the directory header already do. Outside Studio nothing changes (the row end draws nothing there).
- **S1:** with no copilot served, the slot toggle (`studio-slot-toggle`) ends the flow page's title row behind a hairline, is absent from the top bar, is the only one on the page, and hides and shows the slot (aria-pressed and accessible name follow). Control: with a copilot served the same row ends with the AI assistant and no toggle.
- **S2:** PageShell's compact row (actions, Save, hairline, assistant, in the right-aligned group) and the `!embedded` gate on both rows (an embedded row draws neither Save nor the assistant); the directory header (assistant with no hairline; Save then hairline then assistant; control outside Studio); the diagnostics header (assistant last, after Refresh, behind a hairline; control outside Studio).
- **N1:** two components holding the accent on `body`, one unmounted: `body` keeps the classes and the marker; the last unmount removes both. Control: one mount and unmount leaves `body` as found.
- **N4:** dark mode as far as the DOM can say it: the `dark:` variant is read from the app shell's stylesheet; under the `dark` class on the page root, the surface root and `body` both match the variant and carry the accent's dark declarations (graphite `--primary` and `--ring` from `STUDIO_ACCENT_HSL.dark`). Control: under the light theme neither matches.

Each new pin went into the existing harness file for its component as a top-level `describe` (ruling record 6583487846), so no new test file is added.

Read first (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PageShell.tsx`, the `rowHasOwnControls` hunk: the only product line.
2. `StudioDesignSurface.graphite-37455.test.tsx`, the dark-variant block: it reads `styles.css` and matches the variant selector by selector (see Acceptance notes).
3. `StudioDesignSurface.pillarsClaimSlot-12725.test.tsx`, the S1 block.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PageShell.narrowHeader-12306.test.tsx` shows 13 passed, among them the two `N3` cases.

## Tests

All on head `b74f7ff4c7`. Nine ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (mutation proven on disk, restore proven against HEAD), each turned its pin red:

| Ablation | Mutation | Red cases |
|---|---|---|
| A1 slot toggle | the toggle arm returns null when no copilot is served (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, mutation only, restored) | S1 case |
| A2 compact row end | the compact row's `StudioTitleRowEnd` replaced by `null` | 4 (compact order, N3 compact, N3 stats control, Save control) |
| A3 compact embedded gate | `!embedded &&` dropped on the compact row | embedded compact row |
| A4 list embedded gate | `!embedded &&` dropped on the list row | embedded list row |
| A5 N3 guard | `rowHasOwnControls = true` | 2 (N3 compact, N3 list) |
| A6 directory row end | its `StudioTitleRowEnd` deleted | 2 (both directory cases) |
| A7 diagnostics row end | its `StudioTitleRowEnd` deleted | diagnostics case |
| A8 accent counter | the `mountedSurfaces > 0` early return deleted (plain add/remove) | two-mount / one-unmount case |
| A9 dark declarations | `dark:[--primary:220_9%_83%]` removed from `STUDIO_ACCENT` | dark-theme case |

(A2's first attempt was refused by the tool before any run, because its replacement was a suffix of its anchor; it was rerun with a distinct replacement, row above.)

<details><summary>Suite and typecheck readings</summary>

- The five touched suites plus every app-shell test that renders `PageShell` or reads the row end, divider or toggle (15 files): `Test Files 15 passed (15)`, `Tests 240 passed (240)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, which compiles the tests): `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- happy-dom does not match a descendant combinator inside `:where()` (measured: with `dark` on the page root, `body.matches('.dark *')` is true and `body.matches(':where(.dark, .dark *)')` is false). The dark pin therefore splits the variant's selector list and matches each selector, which is what `:where()` means. The light-theme control rules out a pin that passes because nothing matches.
- The S1 pin lives in the slot-claim harness because the flow designer claims the slot from the start (its Configuration), so the toggle is drawn there with nothing selected; the right-slot harness has no page that does.
- The A1 ablation mutated `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` on disk for one run and restored it to HEAD (blob proven equal); the diff does not touch that file, nor `studioMenuModel.ts` or `StudioPackageMenu.tsx`.
- `origin/main` moved to `1af67b26cd` after the branch point; the incoming app-shell change (`ResourceListPage.tsx` and a new record-section module) touches no PageShell prop and none of these files, so the branch was not re-merged.
